items.text: kal tak
do din me
theek hai
haan ji
week ke andar
paise bhej dunga

items.context: Kab payment kar sakte hain aap?
items.text: kal hi kar dunga

items.context: Payment kab tak jaldi karenge aap?
items.text: do hafton me

items.context: Kya aap payment date confirm kar sakte hain?
items.text: thik hai ji
mai 5000 rupees 15 april ko jama kar dunga
maine kal paise transfer kiye the thoda late ho gaya tha
meri salary 20 april ko aati hai uske baad bhej dunga
mujhe 10 din chahiye payment ke liye may be thoda late hoga
main next week me poora amount clear kar dunga
main delhi me hoon aur 5 tarik ko payment kar dunga
please thoda time dijiye 7 din ke andar paise jama kar dunga

items.context: Kab tak payment possible hai aapke liye?
items.text: main 3500 rupees 22 april ko bhej dunga

items.context: Partial payment kar sakte hain kya abhi?
items.text: maine thoda paisa bhej diya baaki chhota amount 2 din me dunga

items.context: Aapko pura amount kab tak dena hai?
items.text: main apne dost ke paas se 25 april tak paise lekar bhej dunga

items.context: Kya aap payment date confirm kar sakte hain?
items.text: thik hai 3 din me paise transfer kar dunga

items.context: Aap payment kab tak kar denge?
items.text: hume 20 april tak payment mil jayega
mera naam Amit Kumar hai aur main Bangalore se bol raha hoon main 30 april tak paise jama kar dunga
maine 12 april ko payment karna tha lekin thoda kaam tha isliye 19 april tak payment kar dunga
mera address sector 12 Noida hai main Mumbai me hoon abhi aur 25 april tak settle kar dunga payment

items.context: Kya aap apna naam aur address confirm kar sakte hain?
items.text: mera naam Ravi Sharma hai main Dwarka Delhi se hoon aur main 28 april tak poora amount renew kar dunga

items.context: Kya aap apna current location aur payment date bata sakte hain?
items.text: main Kolkata me hoon mera address Salt Lake City hai aur 5 may tak aapka payment clear kar dunga

items.context: Kya aap humse apna account number share kar sakte hain?
items.text: main payment me thoda late ho raha hoon mera account no 56789123 hai mujhe 10 din aur chahiye please

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: promise_to_pay - replies to a payment reminder with a date or amount they will pay
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
